title: Reveille toy franc cuer joyeulx (Loyset Compere)
desc: Loyset Compere, Reveille toy franc cuer joyeulx. 3 voices (Superius, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. From the Josquin Research Project (josquin.stanford.edu, Com3033); encoded by Jesse Rodin. Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0; converted to Cantare notation (tools/kern2cantare.py). Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve); coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff. No text in this edition.
